SEN.note: Electronic signature is named only as a security feature of the APPEL procurement platform, not as an authentication service.

facts.fact: ARCOP says it is continuing to deploy the APPEL e-procurement platform, with generalisation targeted from January 2027, a 1 December 2026 deadline to load 2027 procurement plans onto it, and training for more than 325 contracting authorities.

SEN.note: Document is about the procurement platform, not a core finance, tax or payroll system.
No law on electronic transactions or e-commerce is stated.
Document concerns a procurement platform for firms and contracting authorities, not a citizen service portal.
No local government office connection is stated; collectivités territoriales appear only among authorities to be trained.
